name: @unicorne/icons
description: The icons of the base (ADR 0005): optimized SVG, one module per icon loaded on demand, the generator brands build their own icons with, and the icon manifest the documentation tools read (ADR 0044).

scripts.icons: node plugins/cli.ts src --out js --svg-out svg --manifest icon-manifest.json && oxfmt js icon-manifest.json
scripts.icons:check: npm run icons && git diff --exit-code -- js svg icon-manifest.json
